slices.focus: Pilot success with fewer write-ups leads to expansion into all first-year orientation
slices.summary: Early summer numbers show the pilot group had fewer shop safety write-ups and better lab completion, giving Derek clean evidence to present via a bulletin-board-style packet of sign-in sheets, contractor comments, and write-up comparisons. The results earn him an expansion: he is asked to shape orientation and baseline safety for all incoming first-years, not just his pilot section. He now must decide how much of his personal system to transfer into a shared standard that other instructors can carry, while keeping his own energy in check.
